data.title: Scam Merchant High-Velocity Transaction Pattern
data.description: Detects merchant accounts exhibiting high initial transaction velocity, elevated chargeback ratios, and short account age — a pattern consistent with purchase scam merchant operations. Recorded Future identified 3,600+ scam merchant accounts in 2025, a 2.5x increase from 2024, operating across 40+ countries and 230+ acquirers. Scam merchants typically process high transaction volumes within their first 30-90 days to extract maximum revenue before chargeback volume triggers acquirer intervention and account termination. Normal new merchant ramp-up is fewer than 50 transactions per day in the first 30 days, ramping to 200+ by day 90. Scam merchants frequently exceed 200 transactions per day within the first two weeks, combined with chargeback rates exceeding 1.5% within 60 days of account opening. This rule also flags merchants with account ages under 90 days that have already accumulated chargeback ratios above scheme monitoring thresholds.

enrichment_required.source: Account analytics enrichment (daily transaction count aggregation)

falsepositives: Legitimate new merchants running launch promotions or flash sales with high initial transaction volumes
Seasonal merchants (holiday, event-driven) with compressed selling periods
Marketplace merchants migrating transaction history from another acquirer
